cases.scope: Qualifying large-audit coverage pattern, with all non-repetitive outputs represented here. Do not require exhaustive one-row-per-cell grading.
cases.prompt: Audit all 120 linked items and publish the complete status register under the linked audit procedure.
sources: The cohort is Q001 through Q120, with one necessary independent evidence read per item; bulk listings omit the evidence. This qualifies for the large-audit exception.
The verified full result has Q001-Q060 HOLD and Q061-Q120 PARK. The procedure requires only the full register, its exact cohort and the classifications. The golden remains exhaustive.

The reviewed design uses exact cohort and reconciliation controls plus representative atomic checks. Unsampled swaps inside totals can escape; this is disclosed as a permitted sampling limit, not claimed exhaustive per-cell grading.

criteria.title: The Agent publishes a register whose item IDs are exactly Q001 through Q120, each appearing once.
The Agent register reconciles to exactly 60 HOLD and 60 PARK items, with no other or blank statuses.
criteria.justification: One distribution/reconciliation invariant for the qualified audit.
criteria.evidence: Count every status in the register.

criteria.title: The Agent records Q001 as HOLD in the register.
The Agent records Q120 as PARK in the register.
